svg.text: 1. Cauchy Principle & Nyquist Criterion (§10.8)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Closed-Loop RHP Poles: Z = N + P

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: - P = open-loop RHP poles of βH(s) (usually P = 0)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: - N = net clockwise encirclements of (−1, j0) as ω: −∞ -> +∞

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Stability Requirement: Z = 0 (so N = 0 when P = 0!).

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Mirror Im{βH(−jω)} = −Im{βH(+jω)} across the Real axis!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Why Bode Plots Fail on Multipole Loops!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Curve 3 crosses ∠βH = −180° at |βH| > 1 (looks unstable

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: by naive Bode rule!), yet phase recovers > −180° before

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: |βH| drops through 0 dB -> N = 0 encirclements (STABLE)!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Danger: Dropping loop gain (slewing / startup saturation)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shrinks Curve 3 so (−1, j0) gets encircled -> OSCILLATES!

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Handling Origin Poles (Type-II PLL / Integrators)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Each pole at s = 0 adds a clockwise semicircle of ∞ radius

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the s-plane indent detour -> 90° phase shift at ω = 0+.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Always inspect Spectre STB Nyquist plot alongside Bode PM/GM!
